title: fulcher-analyzer: Molecular hydrogen Fulcher-alpha emission analyzer
description:
This release archives the software version used for the H₂ Fulcher-α companion analysis of the revised LHD study.

Changes since v0.2.0:

  • Derives the measured d-state and Boltzmann populations through one consistent Einstein-A path instead of mixing incompatible Einstein-A and Franck–Condon tables.
  • Supports four-band H₂ intensity tables using the packaged diagonal Einstein-A values.
  • Moves the H₂ and D₂ Einstein-A matrices into cited data files, identified as the Lavrov et al. (2015) Tables 5/7 comparison columns.
  • Adds selectable recommended semiempirical H₂/D₂ matrices with uncertainties and independent lifetime regression checks (a_table="semiempirical" in the API, --a-table semiempirical in the batch CLI); the comparison table remains the default.
  • Raises the hot rotational-temperature ceiling to 6000 K and exposes bound contact through BoltzmannPlot.fit_at_bound and the batch-summary flags fit_at_bound, Trot1_at_bound, Trot2_at_bound.
  • Re-freezes the regression reference values of the published D₂ and H₂ reproduction after the population fix (the hot-component and vibrational temperatures move by 1–4 %).

Validation for this release: 52 tests passed; the documentation built successfully in strict mode.
